submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV illumination, the V-rich corner was tested along with the Fe-rich FeVO4-like region. That corner holds BiVO4-type compositions with Fe added. Index 36 (Bi0.29 Fe0.18 V0.53) gave the highest photocurrent, 7e-8 A. The nearby Bi-richer index 30 gave 6e-8 A. The FeVO4-like index 0 gave only 2e-8 A. The merit budget (3) is spent, so 36 is the best measured composition.

rejected.reason: Fe/V-rich (FeVO4-like) composition measured 2e-8 A, well below the Fe-alloyed BiVO4 region
Bi-richer neighbour of 36 measured 6e-8 A, slightly lower

rejected.hypothesis: Bi-rich and Fe-rich corners (BiFeO3 / Bi-rich oxides)
rejected.reason: Not measured because the budget was small; the only data point on the Fe-rich side (index 0) was poor
